headline: Key Fronts Intensify; Bases Trade Hands
war_summary: Three hours after the last edition the war’s centre of gravity remains fixed on the same half‑dozen corridors. Callahans Passage continues to lead the bloodletting, adding roughly 12 000 Colonial and 13 000 Warden dead in the past day and recording 25 base exchanges, the most recent only seconds ago. Weathered Expanse follows with about 8 400 Colonial and 12 700 Warden casualties and 30 ownership changes, the latest minutes ago. Palantine Berm and Nevish Line each logged over 1 000 casualties per side and 30‑plus flips, while Stlican Shelf and Kuura Strand saw 23 and 14 events respectively. Hourly casualty rates are accelerating on Callahans, Palantine and Kuura, but cooling on Weathered, Stlican and Nevish; enlistments are rising on Palantine and Kuura and falling elsewhere. The remaining sectors stay largely static, held wholly by one faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership activity.
